parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

✨
aroma[əˈroʊmə]n.
An aroma is a scent or smell. (mùi thơm, hương vị)
👉 I love the aroma of coffee in the morning.
✨
beverage[ˈbɛvərɪdʒ]n.
A beverage is a drink. (đồ uống, thức uống)
👉 The waiter brought our beverages first. Then he brought our food.
✨
cluster[ˈklʌstər]n.
A cluster of things is a small group of them placed close together. (đám, chùm, cụm)
👉 She held a large cluster of grapes in her hand.
✨
combine[kəmˈbaɪn]v.
To combine is to join together to make a single thing or group. (kết hợp, phối hợp)
👉 Mina combined peanut butter and jelly to make a sandwich.
✨
condensed[kənˈdɛnst]adj.
When a liquid is condensed, it is made thicker. (đặc, cô đặc)
👉 One way to make a dessert thick and sweet is to use condensed milk.
✨
contemporary[kənˈtɛmpəˌrɛri]adj.
When something is contemporary, it is related to the present time. (đương đại, hiện đại)
👉 Contemporary scientists have learned quite a bit about DNA.
✨
cultivate[ˈkʌltəˌveɪt]v.
To cultivate plants is to care for them and help them grow. (trồng trọt, canh tác)
👉 A research company is cultivating new kinds of rice to aid poor countries.
✨
divine[dɪˈvaɪn]adj.
When something is divine, it is related to gods. (thần thánh, thiêng liêng)
👉 Legends say that music was given to men as a divine gift from the gods.
✨
humid[ˈhjumɪd]adj.
When it is humid, there is a lot of water in the air. (ẩm ướt, ẩm)
👉 It is very humid inside of a sauna.
✨
odor[ˈoʊdər]n.
An odor is a very distinct smell. (mùi, mùi đặc trưng)
👉 He knew there was a leak when he noticed the strong odor of natural gas.
✨
palate[ˈpælət]n.
The palate is the top part of the mouth. (vòm miệng, khẩu vị)
👉 You can touch your palate with your tongue.
✨
paradise[ˈpærəˌdaɪs]n.
Paradise is the place or condition of happiness where things are perfect. (thiên đường)
👉 My vacation in Hawaii was like being in paradise.
✨
plantation[plænˈteɪʃən]n.
A plantation is a big farm that only grows certain kinds of crops. (đồn điền, khu đất trồng trọt)
👉 In the 1800s, there were many cotton plantations in the southern US.
✨
rapid[ˈræpɪd]adj.
When something is rapid, it moves or changes very quickly. (nhanh, nhanh chóng)
👉 His mother was surprised by her son’s rapid growth.
✨
rate[reɪt]n.
A rate is the speed at which something happens. (tốc độ, tỉ lệ)
👉 Grass tends to grow at a very slow rate.
✨
soothing[ˈsuðɪŋ]adj.
When something is soothing, it makes you calm or relaxed. (dịu dàng, êm dịu, dễ chịu)
👉 The soothing music helped the baby fall asleep.
✨
subtle[ˈsʌtəl]adj.
When something is subtle, it is not easy to see or notice. (tinh tế, phảng phất, tế nhị)
👉 The handsome man has a subtle smile.
✨
texture[ˈtɛksʧər]n.
The texture of something is the way its surface looks and feels. (kết cấu, bề mặt)
👉 The texture of a rock found in the water is typically very smooth.
✨
toxic[ˈtɑksɪk]adj.
When something is toxic, it is poisonous. Toxic things are very dangerous. (độc hại, có độc)
👉 Please check the label to see if the product is toxic.
✨
vary[ˈvɛri]v.
To vary means to be different from another thing in size or amount. (thay đổi, biến đổi, khác nhau)
👉 The heights of the people in my class vary by a large amount.

sections.title: Exercise 1
sections.content: Choose the word that is the better fit for each blank.

questions.content:
1. rapid / rate
The population growth in the city was incredibly [ 1 ]. It is quite surprising that people settled there at such a fast [ 2 ].

2. contemporary / vary
Many [ 3 ] laws make it illegal for business to compete in unfair ways. However, the specific laws in different countries [ 4 ] greatly.

3. humid / toxic
Because it is quite [ 5 ] on the island, various kinds of plants grow well there. However, some of these plants are [ 6 ] to humans.

4. aroma / texture
The cheese has a smooth [ 7 ]. However, some people find it hard to eat because of its powerful [ 8 ].

5. cluster / combined
A [ 9 ] of people suggested that nearby cities could fight the invaders if they cooperated with each other. As a result, everyone [ 10 ] their efforts and defeated the invaders.

6. soothing / subtle
The artist uses [ 11 ] differences of color in her landscapes. This has an overall calming and [ 12 ] effect on the viewer.

7. cultivated / odor
A huge garden was [ 13 ] in the middle of the city. However, a species of rare plants gave off an unpleasant [ 14 ].

8. beverage / palate
During a four or five course meal, one should drink something to clean the [ 15 ] between courses. The perfect [ 16 ] for this is, of course, water.

9. condensed / divine
I can explain the basic story in a simple, [ 17 ] way. A boy is given a [ 18 ] message, and he begins an exciting adventure.

10. paradise / plantations
The island of Oahu is not a natural [ 19 ] like Maui. However, tourists still visit its many [ 20 ].
questions.explanation: 'rapid' (nhanh chóng) là tính từ phù hợp để mô tả sự gia tăng dân số.
'rate' (tốc độ) phù hợp với cụm từ 'at a fast rate' (với một tốc độ nhanh).
'contemporary' (đương đại/hiện đại) là tính từ bổ nghĩa cho 'laws'.
'vary' (khác nhau) là động từ chính của câu.
'humid' (ẩm ướt) phù hợp với điều kiện khí hậu trên đảo.
'toxic' (có độc) đi kèm với 'to humans' (đối với con người).
'texture' (kết cấu) phù hợp với tính từ 'smooth' (mịn màng).
'aroma' (mùi hương) phù hợp với 'powerful' (mạnh mẽ/nồng).
'A cluster of people' (một nhóm người).
'combined' (kết hợp) là động từ phù hợp cho hành động kết hợp nỗ lực.
'subtle differences' (những sự khác biệt tinh tế).
'soothing effect' (tác dụng êm dịu), đồng nghĩa với 'calming'.
'cultivated' (được trồng trọt) là dạng bị động phù hợp ở đây.
'unpleasant odor' (mùi khó chịu).
'clean the palate' (làm sạch vòm miệng/khẩu vị) là một cụm từ phổ biến.
'beverage' (thức uống) ám chỉ nước trong câu này.
'condensed way' (cách tóm tắt/ngắn gọn).
'divine message' (thông điệp từ thần linh).
'natural paradise' (thiên đường tự nhiên).
'plantations' (đồn điền) là danh từ số nhiều phù hợp.

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
The History of Chocolate

Many people believe that chocolate originally came from Europe. However, chocolate, called the "food of the gods," was first made in the Americas. The first chocolate was very different from contemporary chocolate.

Wild chocolate trees can grow easily in the humid Amazon rainforest. Clusters of flowers growing on these trees turn to seeds. About 20 to 60 cacao beans can be found in the seeds. Cacao beans are the ingredient needed to create sweet, soothing, and delicious chocolate treats.

The Mayan and Aztec cultures both thought that chocolate trees were brought from paradise by gods. The Mayans and Aztecs used the beans from this divine tree to create a special beverage with a very pleasant odor. Surprisingly, the Aztecs believed that it would be toxic to women and children.

In the 1500s, the Spanish explorer Cortes met the Aztecs. Cortes became quite interested in the plantations where the Aztecs cultivated chocolate trees. When he returned to Europe, he took cacao beans with him. He introduced the people of Spain to the Aztecs’ chocolate beverage.

Over the next 100 years or so, kings, queens, and members of the upper class enjoyed drinking chocolate. They enjoyed it even more once they learned to add sugar to the beverage! Soon, chocolate had spread all across Europe. New machines allowed chocolate makers to perfect their products and produce them at a very rapid rate. Preparing the beans in special ways brought out the aroma of chocolate. The beans were combined with condensed milk to give the chocolate a smooth texture.

Today, contemporary chocolates with subtle flavors fill the shelves of expensive chocolate shops. The different types of chocolate available today vary widely. True chocolate lovers can tell which is best, though. They will tell you that the flavor of high quality chocolate stays on the palate long after you finish it.

sections.title: Reading Comprehension Part A
sections.content: True or False

questions.content: Wild chocolate trees grow well in humid weather.
options: True
False
questions.explanation: Cây sô cô la hoang dã phát triển tốt trong thời tiết ẩm ướt, điều này đúng theo bài đọc.

questions.content: The Mayans and Aztecs said chocolate was a divine plant brought from paradise.
options: True
False
questions.explanation: Người Maya và Aztec cho rằng cây sô cô la là một loài cây thần thánh được mang đến từ thiên đường.

questions.content: The Mayans cultivated chocolate trees on plantations.
options: True
False
questions.explanation: The Aztecs cultivated chocolate trees on plantations, không phải người Mayans.

questions.content: Beans were combined with condensed milk to give chocolate a smooth texture.
options: True
False
questions.explanation: Hạt cacao được kết hợp với sữa đặc để tạo cho sô cô la có kết cấu mịn màng.

questions.content: The first chocolate beverages were made in Europe.
options: True
False
questions.explanation: Những thức uống sô cô la đầu tiên được làm ra bởi người Maya và Aztec ở châu Mỹ.

questions.content: The different types of chocolate available today vary widely.
options: True
False
questions.explanation: Các loại sô cô la khác nhau có sẵn ngày nay rất đa dạng và khác biệt.
